zh: 新增两个内置组件：月历与改动。月历按周一起头铺出一个月的日期网格，有安排的日期带点，可以翻到前后月份或回到今天，翻月的位置经 state 存在宿主上；改动卡把统一的 diff 按行铺开，新增与删除标出加减号，文件路径作为分节标题。
en: Adds two built-in widgets: a calendar and a diff. The calendar lays a month out from Monday with a dot on days that have plans, steps to the previous or next month or back to today, and keeps the shown month in host state; the diff card prints a unified diff line by line with add and remove signs and file paths as section headings.
